name: Paracetamol
duration: As needed (3 days, review if fever persists)
warnings: Do not exceed 5 doses in 24 hours
Keep at least 4 hours between doses
Avoid combining with other paracetamol-containing products
notes: 10-15 mg/kg/dose every 4-6 hours. Do not exceed 5 doses per 24 hours.

name: Ibuprofen
warnings: Do not combine with another NSAID
notes: 4-10 mg/kg/dose every 6-8 hours.

name: Mefenamic Acid
warnings: Stop if diarrhoea or rash develops
notes: 6.5 mg/kg/dose three times a day, short course.

name: Amoxicillin
indication: Bacterial infections of ear, throat, chest, urine
warnings: High dose (80-90 mg/kg/day) is used for otitis media / resistant pneumococcus
notes: 20-40 mg/kg/day in divided doses every 8 hours.

name: Amoxicillin + Clavulanate
indication: Resistant ear, sinus, chest, skin, urine infections
food_note: Give at the start of a meal to reduce stomach upset
warnings: Dose by the amoxicillin component, not the total label strength
Use a 7:1 or 14:1 product for higher doses to limit clavulanate-related diarrhoea
notes: 25-45 mg/kg/day (as amoxicillin) in divided doses every 12 hours.

formulations.label: 400/57 mg per 5 ml dry syrup (Duo forte)
600/42.9 mg per 5 ml (ES)
formulations.note: High-dose; dose by the AMOXICILLIN component

name: Cefalexin
indication: Skin, throat, bone and urinary infections
notes: 25-50 mg/kg/day in divided doses.

name: Cefadroxil
notes: 30 mg/kg/day in two divided doses.

name: Cefixime
indication: Respiratory, urinary, typhoid and ENT infections
notes: 8 mg/kg/day divided every 12 hours.

name: Cefpodoxime
indication: Respiratory, ENT, urinary and skin infections
notes: 10 mg/kg/day in two divided doses.

name: Cefuroxime
indication: Respiratory, ENT, skin and urinary infections
notes: 20-30 mg/kg/day in two divided doses with food.

name: Azithromycin
indication: Respiratory, throat, ear, enteric and atypical infections
food_note: Suspension may be given with or without food
notes: 10 mg/kg/day once daily for 3 days.

name: Clarithromycin
notes: 7.5 mg/kg/dose twice daily.

name: Erythromycin
side_effects: Infantile hypertrophic pyloric stenosis in neonates
notes: 30-50 mg/kg/day in divided doses every 6 hours.

name: Cloxacillin
indication: Staphylococcal skin and soft tissue infections
food_note: Give on an empty stomach (1 hour before food)
warnings: Take on an empty stomach for best absorption
notes: 50-100 mg/kg/day in 4 divided doses.

name: Co-trimoxazole (TMP-SMX)
renal_note: Halve the dose if GFR 15-30; avoid if < 15
warnings: Stop at the first sign of rash
notes: Trimethoprim 6-12 mg/kg/day in two divided doses.

formulations.label: 40 mg TMP + 200 mg SMX per 5 ml

name: Metronidazole
hepatic_note: Reduce dose in severe hepatic impairment
notes: 22.5-40 mg/kg/day in three divided doses; up to 50 mg/kg/day for amoebiasis.

formulations.label: 200 mg/5 ml suspension (benzoate)
formulations.note: Check the label: some brands state the benzoate salt

name: Nitrofurantoin
notes: 5-7 mg/kg/day in 4 divided doses for treatment.

name: Linezolid
warnings: Specialist / culture-guided use; monitor blood counts if > 10-14 days
Age 12 y and over: 600 mg twice daily
notes: 10 mg/kg/dose every 8 hours up to age 12 years.

name: Doxycycline
indication: Scrub typhus, rickettsial, atypical and acne infections (age 8 y and over)
food_note: Give with a full glass of water; avoid dairy / antacids within 2 hours
contraindications: Age under 8 years (except severe rickettsial disease)
notes: 2-4 mg/kg/day in two divided doses (max 200 mg/day).

name: Albendazole
duration: Single dose; repeat after 2 weeks if needed
warnings: Repeat after 2 weeks for heavy infection
notes: 200 mg for 1-2 years; 400 mg for 2 years and above.

name: Mebendazole
duration: 3 days (100 mg twice daily); or 500 mg once
notes: 100 mg twice daily for 3 days, or 500 mg as a single dose.

name: Ivermectin
duration: Single dose; repeat after 7-14 days for scabies
food_note: Give on an empty stomach with water
notes: 0.2 mg/kg (200 mcg/kg) as a single dose.

name: Nitazoxanide
notes: 1-3 y: 100 mg; 4-11 y: 200 mg; 12 y and above: 500 mg, twice daily for 3 days.

name: Tinidazole
notes: 50 mg/kg as a single dose (max 2 g).

name: Fluconazole
warnings: 6 mg/kg on day 1, then 3 mg/kg/day is common for oral candidiasis
notes: 3-6 mg/kg once daily.

name: Griseofulvin
indication: Tinea capitis and extensive dermatophyte infections
warnings: Long course; check liver enzymes if prolonged
notes: 10 mg/kg/day (microsize) once daily or in 2 divided doses.

name: Salbutamol (oral)
warnings: Inhaled route (MDI with spacer / nebuliser) is preferred in acute asthma
notes: 0.1-0.15 mg/kg/dose three times a day.

name: Montelukast
notes: 6 months-5 y: 4 mg; 6-14 y: 5 mg; 15 y and above: 10 mg, once daily in the evening.

name: Prednisolone
indication: Asthma exacerbation, croup, allergic and inflammatory conditions
duration: 3-5 days for asthma (no taper needed if < 10 days)
food_note: Give with food, in the morning
warnings: Do not stop abruptly after long courses
notes: 1-2 mg/kg/day, usually a single morning dose (max 60 mg/day).

name: Dexamethasone
indication: Croup, severe allergic / inflammatory conditions, cerebral oedema
warnings: Croup: a single 0.15-0.6 mg/kg dose is usually enough
notes: 0.15-0.6 mg/kg/dose.

name: Ambroxol
warnings: Cough and cold combinations are not recommended below 4 years
notes: 1.2-1.6 mg/kg/day in 2-3 divided doses.

name: Cetirizine
notes: 6-23 m: 2.5 mg once daily; 2-5 y: 2.5 mg twice daily; 6-11 y: 5 mg twice daily; 12 y and above: 10 mg once daily.

name: Levocetirizine
notes: 6 m-5 y: 1.25 mg; 6-11 y: 2.5 mg; 12 y and above: 5 mg, once daily in the evening.

name: Hydroxyzine
notes: 1-2 mg/kg/day in 3 divided doses (max 100 mg/day).

name: Chlorpheniramine
warnings: Combination cough / cold products are not recommended below 4 years
notes: 0.35 mg/kg/day in divided doses.

name: Ondansetron
hepatic_note: Max 8 mg/day in severe hepatic impairment
notes: 0.15 mg/kg/dose up to three times a day (max 8 mg/dose).

name: Domperidone
warnings: Use at the lowest dose for the shortest time
notes: 0.25 mg/kg/dose up to three times a day (max 30 mg/day).

name: Omeprazole
indication: Gastro-oesophageal reflux, peptic ulcer, H. pylori
hepatic_note: Reduce dose in severe hepatic impairment
warnings: Do not crush capsules; open and mix pellets with soft food
notes: 1 mg/kg/day once daily (max 40 mg).

name: Pantoprazole
notes: 0.5-1 mg/kg/day once daily (max 40 mg).

name: Zinc (elemental)
warnings: Give for the full 14 days even after the diarrhoea stops
notes: Under 6 months: 10 mg/day; 6 months and above: 20 mg/day for 14 days.

formulations.label: 20 mg elemental dispersible tablet
formulations.note: Dissolve in a little water / ORS

name: Racecadotril
notes: 1.5 mg/kg/dose three times a day.

name: Lactulose
duration: Until stools are regular; wean gradually
warnings: Reduce the dose if stools are loose
notes: 1-3 ml/kg/day in 1-2 divided doses (volume).

formulations.label: 10 g/15 ml solution
formulations.note: Dose is the volume; label strength shown for reference

name: Bisacodyl
warnings: Do not use for long periods
Not for children under 4 years without advice
notes: 4-9 y: 5 mg; 10 y and above: 5-10 mg once daily at night.

name: Phenobarbitone
warnings: Specialist follow-up; monitor levels if needed
interactions: Many (enzyme inducer): valproate, warfarin, oral contraceptives
notes: 3-5 mg/kg/day maintenance (single or divided).

name: Sodium Valproate
warnings: Avoid in adolescent girls where possible (teratogenic)
notes: 20-30 mg/kg/day in 2 divided doses.

name: Levetiracetam
notes: Start 10 mg/kg twice daily; maintenance 20-60 mg/kg/day in 2 divided doses.

name: Carbamazepine
notes: 10-20 mg/kg/day in 2 divided doses.

name: Topiramate
notes: Start 1-3 mg/kg/day; maintenance 5-9 mg/kg/day in 2 divided doses.

name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)
warnings: Prophylactic doses shown. Treatment (e.g. 2,000 IU/day for 6-12 weeks, or 60,000 IU weekly) is set by the doctor
notes: Prophylaxis: 400 IU/day under 1 year; 600 IU/day above.

name: Ferrous Salts (elemental iron)
duration: 3 months, continue 1-3 months after haemoglobin normalises
food_note: Between meals if tolerated; with vitamin C
warnings: Keep out of reach: iron overdose is dangerous in children
notes: Therapeutic 3 mg/kg/day elemental iron in 1-2 doses (prophylaxis 1-2 mg/kg/day).

name: Folic Acid
warnings: Therapeutic doses for megaloblastic anaemia are higher (5 mg/day); the figures shown are supplementation doses
notes: 0.5 mg/day under 1 year; 1 mg/day above (supplementation).

formulations.label: 5 mg tablet
formulations.note: A 1 mg dose is one-fifth of a tablet: use a liquid / 1 mg product

name: Oseltamivir
warnings: Doses are by weight; under 1 year the dose is 3 mg/kg twice daily
notes: By weight: 15 kg or less 30 mg; 15-23 kg 45 mg; 23-40 kg 60 mg; over 40 kg 75 mg, twice daily for 5 days.

name: Acyclovir
duration: 5 days (start within 24 hours of the rash)
notes: Chickenpox: 20 mg/kg/dose four times a day (max 800 mg/dose).

name: Artemether + Lumefantrine
food_note: Give with fatty food or milk
notes: By weight: 5-14 kg 1 tablet; 15-24 kg 2; 25-34 kg 3; 35 kg and above 4, twice daily for 3 days.
